title: Connectors
intro_before: Tool servers your assistants call while a caller is on the line. Most of them are not ours: you or someone else runs them, and Tel-Agent only decides which of their tools may run. The other direction — Tel-Agent offering its own tools to Claude or a script — lives in
empty_body: Your assistants can still answer questions and book appointments through the built-in apps. An MCP server is for the software that has no app yet — your own database, a practice system, an internal script.
warning_note: These connectors are not ours. Tel-Agent does not review the code behind them, and a tool can do anything the server lets it do. Every tool arrives switched off, and you decide per assistant which ones may run during a call.
tools_note: A tool switched on here still has to be picked per assistant.
assistants_none: No assistant uses this connector yet.
c_calendar_desc: Wraps the CalDAV server so the assistant can offer real slots instead of promising a call back.
c_records_desc: A thin read-only layer over the customer database. No write tool is exposed at all, by design.
c_tomedo_desc: Community bridge to the Tomedo practice system. Maintained outside Tel-Agent; updates arrive when its author ships them.
c_tomedo_error_body: The bridge answers, but Tomedo refuses its key. Nothing broke on the Tel-Agent side — the practice password was most likely changed this morning.
c_stripe_desc: The only server here that runs outside your network. Caller numbers are sent to Stripe when a payment is looked up.
c_billing_desc: Added last week and never started. Its tools stay invisible to every assistant until it connects once.
tool_check_calendar_desc: Free slots for a given day or range.
tool_book_appointment_desc: Writes an appointment and returns the confirmation id.
tool_cancel_appointment_desc: Removes an appointment. Off — cancellations go through a person.
tool_lookup_customer_desc: Matches a caller number to a customer record.
tool_order_status_desc: Reads the state of an order by number.
tool_list_invoices_desc: Returns open invoices. Off — payment talk goes to a person.
tool_find_patient_desc: Matches a caller to a patient record.
tool_next_free_slot_desc: Reads the next opening for a treatment type.
tool_payment_status_desc: Reads whether an invoice was paid.
tool_create_payment_link_desc: Sends a payment link by SMS. Off — never take card details on a call.
tool_draft_invoice_desc: Creates a draft invoice from a call summary.
tool_invoice_status_desc: Reads whether an invoice is open.
tool_create_order_desc: Creates an order from what the caller asked for.
step3_title: Which tools an assistant may use
dlg_name_help: What you will call it in the assistant’s tool list.
hosted_warn: This one runs outside your network. Whatever a tool receives — a caller’s number, a name, an order — leaves the building. It will be listed in the consent log.
handshake_ok: The server answered and offers 3 tools. Nothing is switched on yet.
step3_note: Everything arrives off. Switch on only what you want an assistant to be able to do while someone is on the line.
kind_stdio_note: A program Tel-Agent starts and talks to over stdio.
kind_http_note: An HTTP server you already run, reachable from here.
kind_hosted_note: A hosted MCP server. Data leaves your network.
